src='''def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    # Extend diagonal colored rays identified by adjacent equal-colored cells.
    rays=set()
    for r in range(h-1):
        for c in range(w):
            for dc in (-1,1):
                nr,nc=r+1,c+dc
                if 0<=nc<w and g[r][c]==g[nr][nc] and g[r][c]!=g[0][0]:
                    rays.add((nr,nc,1,dc,g[nr][nc]))
    for r,c,dr,dc,v in rays:
        rr,cc=r+dr,c+dc
        while 0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w:
            if g[rr][cc]==g[0][0]: g[rr][cc]=v
            rr+=dr; cc+=dc
    return g
'''
p.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True); p.write_text(src)
